product_one_liner.value: SER Group, now Doxis, provides AI-powered document management and content automation for enterprises to capture, analyze, manage and automate documents across business processes.
product_one_liner.notes: The rebranding announcement describes AI-powered document management and intelligent content automation across organizations' document lifecycles: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-rebrands-to-doxis

pricing_page.notes: The public /pricing URL describes unlimited-license and subscription-based licensing choices. It qualifies under the rule allowing plans without numeric prices, although the page emphasizes deployment and licensing rather than a conventional price table: https://sergroup.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Eissmann appears on the customer references page, and the Northmarq announcement explicitly calls Northmarq a new customer. Sources: https://www.sergroup.com/en/references.html ; https://www.sergroup.com/en/about-us/news-press/northmarq-selects-ser-to-enhance-cx.html | named_customers.0: Named on the customer references page: https://www.sergroup.com/en/references.html | named_customers.1: Explicitly described as a new customer: https://www.sergroup.com/en/about-us/news-press/northmarq-selects-ser-to-enhance-cx.html

employee_band.notes: The company reports more than 900 employees, exceeding every permitted band. Null avoids assigning an incorrect band; the headcount itself is not unknown. Source: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly identifies Bonn as its headquarters city: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-welcomes-new-investment | hq_country: The company announcement explicitly identifies Bonn, Germany as its headquarters: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-welcomes-new-investment

founded_year.notes: Carlyle explicitly states that SER was founded in 1984: https://www.carlyle.com/media-room/news-release-archive/carlyle-group-acquires-majority-stake-ser-group-european-ecm

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents business-process, product and educational content, not two identifiable engineer-authored accounts of how Doxis is built internally. This is an index-based negative, not proof that no technical writing exists elsewhere: https://www.doxis.com/en/blog

public_docs.notes: The public Doxis AI.dp documentation portal provides API documentation, SDK implementation guides and multiple platform-documentation sections: https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Full Stack AI Engineer posting explicitly says the company is hiring three engineers for its Klippa business: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers/AIKlippa

model_provider.notes: SER explicitly says it integrates Azure Form Recognizer for layout and text recognition: https://www.sergroup.com/en/knowledge-center/blog/7-ai-trends-of-content-management.html

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company explicitly claims SOC 2 certification, ISO 27001 certification and EU GDPR certification. Sources: https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification/soc2.html ; https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification/iso-27001.html ; https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification.html | compliance_certs.0: Explicitly claims successful SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2 certification: https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification/soc2.html | compliance_certs.1: Explicitly states that SER achieved ISO 27001 certification: https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification/iso-27001.html | compliance_certs.2: The certification index explicitly labels Doxis EU GDPR-certified: https://www.sergroup.com/en/business-platform/certification.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live company careers page is titled Business Development Representative (m/f/d), a qualifying role; its description also discusses progression into an Account Executive role: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers/business-development-representative-m-f-d

launched_6mo.notes: Doxis announced a new generation of AI-powered Document Intelligence innovations at its May 20–21, 2026 Summit, within the six-month window. The excerpt establishes an innovation launch but does not enumerate individual features: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/doxis-summit-2026-document-intelligence-innovations

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement states that Andy Spence joins as Chief Revenue Officer, within the preceding 12 months: https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/news-press/ser-group-rebrands-to-doxis

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The GTM Automation Analyst posting names Salesforce Account Engagement, Salesloft, Clay, Cognism and 6sense as platforms involved in its workflows.
